# Zalo Gateway - LLM & AI Agent Context
> High-performance Go native bridge, web client, and automation gateway for Zalo personal accounts.

## Core Capabilities
- REST API for sending and querying Zalo messages.
- Real-time WebSockets on /ws for bidirectional chat events.
- Outbound Webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 signatures for n8n, Make, Flowise, and autonomous agent loops.
- Multi-session Web UI enabling unlimited concurrent browser connections without Zalo session logout.

## Base URLs
- Local: http://localhost:54321
- REST API Base: http://localhost:54321/api/v1
- WebSocket: ws://localhost:54321/ws
- OpenAPI 3.0: http://localhost:54321/api/v1/openapi.json

## Quick Actions for AI Agents
1. Send Message:
   POST /api/v1/send
   Headers: Content-Type: application/json
   Body: {"thread_id": "<user_or_group_id>", "message": "<content>", "is_group": false}

2. Read Recent Messages:
   GET /api/v1/messages?limit=10

3. List Threads:
   GET /api/v1/threads

4. Check Connection:
   GET /api/v1/status
